Frequently asked questions

Can the client see internal discussions between lawyers?

Only what happens in the shared dossier chat is visible to everyone involved. Private one-on-one conversations are visible exclusively to the two participants.

What if someone is involved in multiple dossiers?

That's the normal situation. Each person sees a list of their dossiers with unread counters, and can switch between them instantly — each dossier keeps its own chat, files and agenda.

Do clients need to install anything?

No. Everything works in the browser. The iOS and Android app is optional — it adds push notifications for people who want to stay up to date on the go.

Is the chat history part of the case record?

Yes. The chat, notes and document activity form one chronological record of the dossier, and every action is logged for the firm admin.

Can I share documents inside the chat?

Yes — drop a document straight into the conversation, or upload it to the dossier outside the chat. Either way it becomes part of the dossier's file collection.
